correctness.rationale: Hou's strict-tournament specialization is exact: the domination case implies gamma eligibility; gamma tests the universal nonempty intersections because the pivot always beats the bottom block; beta tests a full intersection for an upper vertex. The empty-bottom branch contributes one point to each incoming neighbor. Set-valued score ties are retained. The independently written NumPy Boolean-adjacency census partitions the label-mask ranges into disjoint chunks, checks all 2, 8, 64, 1024, 32768 and 2097152 cases, and obtains 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 and 5040 failures. It verifies exact equality of the failing-mask set and the witness relabeling set, with all 7! masks distinct, and winner sizes (Copeland, DSR, intersection)=(1,2,1) throughout. Replay: python3 /workspace/reviews/evidence/dsr_census.py; output reviews/evidence/dsr_census.txt. Neither the original code nor a sample is relied on. The claim says nothing for n>=8.
